title: koanophyllon palmeri
intro: Koanophyllon palmeri, commonly known as Mexican feathergrass, is a perennial grass species native to Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Koanophyllon palmeri include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
